title: Kasia v. Demi: Worlds Provided Another Chapter in One of Cycling’s Great Rivalries
content:
In a sport with its history defined by one-on-one battles, the tow-up sprint finish between Demi Vollering and Kasia Niewiadoma showed just how special the rivalry has become.

Read the full article at Kasia v. Demi: Worlds Provided Another Chapter in One of Cycling’s Great Rivalries on Velo.
author: Logan Jones-Wilkins
